name: User
description: Store user information for both support agents and customers/employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: 'agent' or 'customer' for access control

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for authentication

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Account status indicating if user can access the system

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.email: Must be valid email format and unique

name: TicketCategory
description: Defines ticket categories for organizing and routing support tickets by type or department

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., Hardware, Software, Network)

fields.name: parentCategoryId
fields.description: Reference to parent category for hierarchical organization (null for top-level categories)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what tickets belong in this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the category is currently active and available for ticket assignment

fields.name: routingDepartment
fields.description: Default department or team to route tickets in this category

fields.name: displayOrder
fields.description: Sort order for displaying categories in lists and dropdowns

name: Ticket
description: Central data model for storing and tracking IT support requests through their lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the support request

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., open, in_progress, resolved, closed)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (e.g., low, medium, high, critical)

fields.name: submitterId
fields.description: Reference to the User who submitted the ticket

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: Reference to the User (agent) assigned to handle the ticket

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to the TicketCategory for classification

relationships.description: Ticket is submitted by a User
Ticket is assigned to an agent (User)

indexes.description: Index on status for efficient filtering
Index on submitter for user ticket lookups
Index on assigned agent for workload queries

name: TicketComment
description: Store comments and updates made on tickets by agents and customers

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this comment belongs to

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: commentText
fields.description: The actual content of the comment or update

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Visibility flag - true for internal agent notes, false for customer-visible comments

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is authored by one user

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order
Optimize queries for comments by a specific user

name: TicketHistory
description: Maintains complete audit trail of all ticket changes and status transitions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that was modified

fields.name: fieldName
fields.description: Name of the field that was changed (e.g., status, priority, assignee)

fields.name: oldValue
fields.description: Previous value before the change

fields.name: newValue
fields.description: New value after the change

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the change occurred

relationships.description: Each history record belongs to one ticket
Each history record is created by one user

constraints.retentionPolicy: Retain indefinitely for compliance and audit purposes

name: Notification
description: Store and track notifications sent to users about ticket events

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user receiving the notification

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: ID of the ticket related to this notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (ticket_created, ticket_assigned, ticket_updated, comment_added, status_changed)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel for the notification (email, in-app, both)

fields.name: content
fields.description: Notification message content

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Whether the notification has been read by the user

relationships.description: Notification is related to a ticket
